posts.title: Porting micro to WASM + WASI
posts.description: I’ve been experimenting with WASM a few times before. Getting normal C projects compiling under WASM has always been rather finnicky. For once, gcc and clang do not support WASM as a main target out of the box, you’re therefore forced to find another way to reach your desired output. posts.title: Chronicles of the lost pixel framework
posts.description: So, this story requires a bit of context. It kind of started in 2022. Back then, I had been playing from time to time with PICO-8. PICO-8 is a pretty awesome and charming little fantasy console to create retro games in a resolution of 128x128 pixels.
